title: A Survey on Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on the general and specific capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models, such as recognition, perception, reasoning, trustworthiness, and performance in domains like science, medicine, and engineering.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the study.
